description: This Java class 'CustomAuthenticationProvider' extends Spring Security's 'DaoAuthenticationProvider' to add custom logic for handling locked user accounts during authentication. It checks if a user is locked and whether the lock period has expired, throwing a LockedException with a message if the user is still locked.
